import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch. Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# Patch name -> branch name conversion.
is_patch = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_patch:
        # Patch ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

I wrote a plan for this change. It passed validation and is now staged for your approval as a single-agent medium plan. Nothing has been implemented yet.

**What the plan changes:** Command-X in the Go To picker will flip between two views that never overlap: open tasks only, and completed tasks only.

**How it gets there:**
- **bob-cli first.** `bob capture-complete -C`/`--closed-tasks` will return completed tasks *instead of* open ones, rather than adding them after the open list. Without the flag, the output stays exactly as it is today.
  - The fix belongs in bob because the Mac app is meant to only display what bob returns. Filtering on the Mac side would leave bob with a mode nothing uses.
  - Changing what the flag means is safe: it was added today and hasn't been in any release yet (the latest is v0.4.0 from Oct 27). The implementing agent will re-check that before committing.
- **Mac app second.** The app still sends the same flag. Only its wording changes:
  - Header: `Go To · + Completed` becomes `Go To · Completed`.
  - Footer hint: `⌘X Hide Completed` becomes `⌘X Show Open`.
  - Screen-reader text and status messages change to match.
  - The plan also covers test fixtures and tests, the Mac docs, and a duplicated `## Go To Picker` heading in `docs/task-pickers.md`.
- **Unchanged:**
  - Completed tasks still come from the whole vault, including archives in `done/`.
  - Canceled tasks still appear, as you chose for that epic. I read "done tasks" in your request as both done and canceled tasks, so say so if you want canceled ones left out.
  - Each new Go To session still starts on open tasks, and Escape and reopening still keep your current choice.

**Two gates already fail on master for reasons unrelated to this work.** The plan tells the implementer not to fix them here, so each will still fail after this lands:
- `just docs-check` fails because `docs/develop/decisions.md` is out of date, which is already tracked on bob-cli-b6.
- `cargo fmt --all --check` fails on unformatted files that belong to the open bob-cli-h2 epic.
